name: Wooden Pen Holder With Photo Frame
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality wood (5mm thickness) combined with clear acrylic panels (2mm thickness).
    - Durable, sturdy, and designed for long-term daily use.
    - Structure:
                    +) Base: 2-layer wooden base (5mm each) for stability.
                    +) Pen holder box: wooden panels (5mm) assembled with strong finger joints.
                    +) Frame supports: wooden (5mm), hold acrylic panels securely.
                    +) Photo frame: 2 acrylic sheets (2mm each).
                    +) Built-in slots for inserting a photo frame and holding a phone or stationery.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 24 x 13.2 cm ~ 9.4 x 5.2 in.
    - Photo frame size: 15.5 x 12 cm ~ 6.1 x 4.7 in.
    - Pen holder box: approx. 10 x 8 x 7 cm ~ 3.9 x 3.1 x 2.7 in.
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customize the printed design only.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for sharp, vibrant, and long-lasting colors
    - Wooden parts: printed on 1 side or 2 sides depending on design
    - Acrylic panels:
                    +) Option 1: No printing (for inserting and changing photos)
                    +) Option 2: 1-sided UV printing directly on acrylic (fixed design, non-changeable)

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Multi-functional design combining pen holder, photo frame, and desk organizer.
    - Keeps pens, scissors, and small items neatly organized.
    - Displays your favorite photo or custom design in a clean, modern way.
    - Easy to insert and replace photos (for changeable version).
    - Suitable for use on office desks, study tables, or home decor spaces.
    - Helps keep your workspace tidy while adding a personal touch.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful and practical gift for family, friends, coworkers, or teachers.
    - Perfect for occasions like Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays.
    - Combines personalization and functionality, making it both decorative and useful.
    - A thoughtful way to showcase memories while enhancing everyday workspace🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Wooden Pen Holder With Photo Frame

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
